summaryZh: Nimmerjahn 实验室开发显微成像和分析工具，研究胶质细胞在健康或患病中枢神经系统中的作用。实验室将显微镜微型化为可穿戴设备，并开发细胞类型特异性染色、遗传操控和大规模成像数据分析工具。
researchQuestions: 胶质细胞在完整、健康或患病的中枢神经系统中发挥何种作用？
topics: 胶质细胞与中枢神经系统功能
健康和疾病中的胶质细胞作用
显微成像及数据分析工具

evidence.quote: Axel Nimmerjahn, PhD Professor Waitt Advanced Biophotonics Center Victor Wild Endowed Chair Salk Institute for Biological Studies
To enable cellular-resolution measurements under naturalistic conditions, his lab has worked to shrink the size of microscopes to make them wearable.

Additionally, they have created new tools for cell type-specific staining and genetic manipulation and for analysis of large-scale imaging data. This has allowed them to address long-standing questions regarding the role of glial cells in the intact healthy or diseased CNS.
Nimmerjahn’s lab used cutting-edge microscopy approaches to visualize the blood-brain barrier breakdown after stroke.
